title: Brass skeleton key
prompt: A single antique brass skeleton key viewed from directly above, lying at a slight angle on a transparent background. Vintage engraving style: fine hatched linework, warm brass tones, an ornate bow with a clover-shaped cutout, a long stem, and a single toothed bit. No background shapes, no text.

prompt-fidelity.note: The 'clover-shaped cutout' renders as three separate round holes; the lobes never merge into a clover.

geometry.note: The bit floats visibly clear of the stem tip — a detached join the model did not close.

color.note: Flat fills; the brass warmth is carried by the hatch overlays rather than tonal modeling.
